short_title: Cell typing into 15 classes incl. DA-OL state
method: QC, Leiden, LLM/CyteType labels, OL Louvain subclustering
key_result: 15 classes; DA-OL 15,261 cells = 64.7%, 42.6%, 21.4% of OLs in RB4405/RB4627/RB4401 vs <=2.3% elsewhere

short_title: Read-based anatomical compartments, 12 regions
method: 20-neighbour pooled expression, Leiden, manual Allen naming
key_result: 12 regions (cortex 259k ... vasculature 8k cells); later shown disease-distorted: responder pallidum absorbed into fibre tracts (§43)

short_title: Earlier group DE claimed P21 modest, P60 strong
method: cell t-tests; pseudobulk pyDESeq2 per class/region/age
key_result: Mature OL padj<0.05: 4 genes P21 vs 14 P60; Trib3 log2FC 3.89 vs 5.10; age pattern explained by 1 vs 2 responders

short_title: Hierarchical Bayesian case-control models of mtDSB vs control
method: NumPyro SVI per gene; PyMC per gene on pseudobulk
validation: FDR via PEP; no held-out check
key_result: 22/22 driver genes same direction, 12 FDR<0.05, shifts <=0.17; PyMC beta[1] is a level not effect; age run incomplete

short_title: OL sub-states: DA-OL cluster, modules, myelin score
method: OL subclustering, signature scores, sample pseudotime
key_result: DA-OL markers Gstp1, Atf4, Atf5, H2-D1, Serpina3n; myelin score lowest in RB4405, RB4627, RB4401; real but only 3 of 6 mtDSB

short_title: Pathway, MS-serum, metabolic, MANA, EAE and NSC explorations
method: module scores, decoupler ULM, sccellfie, MANA, integration
data: OL lineage and all cells; RR/chronic EAE 5k
key_result: cGAS-STING 0.070 vs 0.080 cell means, no replicate test; no responder pattern; NSC proliferation is section plane

short_title: Claim-by-claim review of earlier analyses after responder finding
method: per-animal CPM re-check of each earlier claim
key_result: 10 claims confirmed (responder-only), 11 explained by responder composition or confounds, ~35 notebooks without conclusions

short_title: Region x age pseudobulk DE pipeline, mtDSB vs control
method: pyDESeq2 Wald per cell type x region x age
key_result: 2,024 hits, 1,325 NSC P60 artefact; OL P60 only Mt2, Gfap, Gpnmb, Atf5 (padj 0.048); Trib3 log2FC 4.0 not significant

short_title: Does the treatment effect change between P21 and P60?
method: pyDESeq2 age x condition interaction per cell type x region
key_result: 358 interaction hits, none an OL stress gene (all padj 1.0); OL hits are neuropeptides; Gdf15 log2FC 2.72 P21 vs 2.76 P60

short_title: Predefined ISR gene set calls three responders
method: Prespecified 10-gene ISR CPM in OL pseudobulk, control-max rule
key_result: 3/6 mtDSB mice 1.35-1.57x highest control; variance F p=0.013, Brown-Forsythe p=1e-4; means not different (p=0.15)

short_title: Three independent readouts pick the same three mice
method: ISR score, LOSO OL classifier, DA-OL cluster share; Spearman
key_result: Same top 3 on all readouts; Spearman 0.56-0.71; DA-OL share 22-65% vs <=2.3% elsewhere

short_title: Why plain condition classifiers fail; technical checks
method: LOSO logistic regression per cell type x region; permutation p
key_result: Condition 0/101 strata p<0.05 vs age 52/101 FDR<0.1; P60-trained model ranks P21 responder top; sex, genotype, slide ruled out

short_title: Response is brain-wide, strongest in thalamus and fibre tracts
method: Per-region readouts vs control mean; within-animal region ranks; OL maps
validation: Three readouts; later disease-free region map
data: OL pseudobulk + single OLs, original region map
key_result: Every region up (ISR 1.23-1.88x); fibre tracts and thalamus mean rank 2.7; 31-55% responder OLs above control p90

short_title: Other cell types: only weak untested classifier hints
method: LOSO single-cell classifiers per cell type, cross-cohort transfer AUC
key_result: Condition AUC ~0.5 everywhere; transfer AUC 0.67-1.0 in astrocytes, endothelium, microglia; hypotheses only

short_title: Within-section driver genes of the OL response
method: Within-section gene vs classifier-score correlation; prefixed driver rule
unit: cell within section; rule per mouse
validation: Rule fixed beforehand; glucocorticoid and neuron checks
key_result: 34 up (Trib3, Atf5, Cdkn1a, Cd40, H2-D1), 9 myelin down; 6/10 prior ISR genes recovered

short_title: Top classifier genes replicate across disjoint mice
method: P21-only vs P60-only OL classifiers; top-k overlap
key_result: Top-50 up overlap 10 vs 0.5 expected (p=2e-11), but includes glucocorticoid genes Zbtb16, Plin4

short_title: Glia next to stressed OLs are more activated in responders
method: Region-centred correlation of glial gene-set score with local OL ISR
key_result: Astro reactivity r 0.056 vs -0.039, microglial MHC-I 0.031 vs 0.001 (p=0.012); endothelium none (p=0.87)

short_title: ISR before myelin loss: cross-sectional staging
method: Smoothed ISR and myelin percentiles vs same-slide-region controls
key_result: P(myelin-low | ISR-high) 0.40, 0.73, 0.90 with severity vs 0.09-0.25 in controls (p=0.012)

short_title: Microglial expression predicts distance to stressed OLs
method: Ridge regression on own expression, OL-related genes removed
validation: Leave-one-mouse-out; controls as null; transfer test
key_result: Microglia held-out r 0.17 vs 0.10 in controls, every responder above every control (p=0.012); endothelium none

short_title: Next-cohort design and power by test
method: Simulation from observed per-mouse ISR; four tests compared
key_result: Group-mean test 0.45 power at 6/group; per-mouse tests 0.8 at ~10; with induction QC 0.8-0.9 at 5-6

short_title: OL stress is not concentrated near ventricles or meninges
method: Region-centred rank correlation of stress with log border distance
data: Xenium OL ISR scores, centroids, old region map
key_result: No rise towards ventricle (p = 0.10) or meninges (p = 0.25); responders slightly more stressed farther away

short_title: Stress is diffuse within regions, not focal patches
method: Spatial correlogram of raw per-cell ISR, region-centred
data: Xenium OL ISR scores and centroids
key_result: Neighbour coherence equals controls in every band 0-400 um (p 0.08-0.89; r about 0.05 in both groups)

short_title: No repair: immature OLs not increased near stressed OLs
method: Neighbourhood coupling and local density of immature OLs
key_result: Local immature-OL density vs stress p = 0.98; 2.7% vs 2.9% immature OLs; pre-myelinating hints p = 0.07

short_title: No neuronal axon-injury or ISR response near stressed OLs
method: Neighbourhood coupling of neuron readouts to local OL stress
key_result: No consistent response; one unreported nominal hit (generic Neurons, axon injury p = 0.036)

short_title: Probability that each mtDSB mouse responded
method: Exact two-component Bayesian mixture anchored on slide controls
validation: Control null, prior sensitivity, simulated operating characteristics
data: Per-mouse OL ISR, per-OL ISR, classifier
key_result: 3 mice P > 0.99; RB4630 P = 0.17; no control above 0.08; next-cohort cut-off 1.17x controls

short_title: T cells called by co-expression; Trbc1 and Ighm off-target
method: Core-gene co-expression call against within-section shuffle null
validation: Gene shuffle null (20 reps), threshold grid
key_result: 242 T cells vs 3.9 in shuffle null; Trbc1 and Ighm lit in 30k / 68k mostly neuronal cells

short_title: T cells carry neighbours' labels and sit at borders
method: Label tallies, section maps, polygon close-ups
validation: Visual inspection of polygons and transcripts
key_result: No lymphocyte label; 55% endothelial / leptomeningeal, 18% astrocyte, 15% DA-OL clusters

short_title: Responders do not have more T cells
method: Per-section T-cell density and position compared
key_result: 3.4 vs 2.8 per 10k, p = 0.46; OL-labelled share 0.30 vs 0.11, p = 0.06

short_title: Non-responders hide no responding OLs, overall or regionally
method: Leave-own-section-out control percentiles; upper-tail enrichment
validation: Controls scored the same way; leave-one-out reference
key_result: Top 1% share 0.6-1.2x in non-responders vs 0.9-1.2x controls and 5-8x responders

short_title: Detection limit and responding share of OLs per mouse
method: Spike-in simulation and nonparametric mixture lower bound
validation: Planting responder-like cells into control sections
key_result: Would catch >= 3% responding OLs (98%); responders >= 20-36% OLs respond (ISR)

short_title: mtDSB OL ISR / p21 arm is absent in EAE OLs
method: Per-mouse pseudobulk log2 FC compared gene by gene, programme
data: mtDSB Xenium; RR-map EAE atlas, 59 EAE + 8 control mice
key_result: ISR programme +1.8 log2 in mtDSB vs +0.1-0.2 in EAE lesions; IFN-gamma +0.3 vs +3.1

short_title: No EAE stage switches on the OL ISR
method: Per-mouse OL ISR z-score against study controls, by stage
data: RR-map EAE per-cell scores; mtDSB OL scores
key_result: EAE max z 4.1 vs responders 4.0-8.9; overlaps mildest responder, gene-level FC agrees

short_title: Microglia and astrocytes react alike in mtDSB and EAE
method: Pseudobulk log2 FC correlation and gene-set means
key_result: Microglia r = 0.61, DAM +2.6 vs +2.5; astrocytes r = 0.43, reactive +0.8 vs +3.0

short_title: More microglia in responder thalamus and fibre tracts; pallidum seemed missing
method: Cells per mm2 per region; exact permutation over mice
data: Xenium cell table, original region labels, 980k cells
key_result: Microglia thalamus 92-153 vs 60-82 /mm2, fibre tracts 71-219 vs 51-68 (p = 0.012); screen alone fails FDR (q = 0.25)

short_title: Microglia excess in OL-rich squares regardless of region labels; modest proliferation
method: 100 um squares by OL fraction; depth-adjusted proliferation GLM
data: Xenium cell table and gene-set scores
key_result: Microglia up in 10-50 % OL squares (p = 0.012-0.024), not OL-poor; proliferating 15-17 % vs 11-15 % (p = 0.012)

short_title: Microglia not clustered around the most stressed OLs
method: Microglia within 50 um by OL ISR percentile band
unit: mouse; OLs within section x region
validation: Controls' own top OLs as crowding control
key_result: Top-1 % OLs have 1.05-1.28x microglia in responders vs 0.90-1.15x in controls (p = 0.14): diffuse

short_title: Per-cell-type DE with a spill-over model: own vs neighbours' RNA
method: pyDESeq2 per type plus linear marker-based mixing model
key_result: Non-responders 0-4 hits; neurons 26/38 hits spill-over; own responses: microglia 135, astrocytes 32, OLs 33, endothelial 46

short_title: Astrocyte interferon response is small, patchy, not near stressed OLs
method: IFN-positive astrocyte share; within-section density-adjusted correlations
key_result: IFN+ astrocytes fibre tracts 12.8-19.4 % vs 7.1-10.9 % (p = 0.012), but non-responder 23 %; coupling r within +/-0.03

short_title: Neural stem cell 'proliferation' reflects which ventricle is in the section
method: Per-cell niche markers (Foxg1, Tbx3) and proliferation transcripts
key_result: Within Foxg1+ NSCs proliferation equals controls (p = 0.38); P60 controls 11-14 % Tbx3+ vs 0-0.7 % responders

short_title: OL pathway map: ATF4 and p53 up, no cGAS-STING or mitophagy
method: Prespecified pathway scores on slide-centred OL pseudobulk
validation: Spill-over fraction per gene; non-responders; FDR
key_result: ATF4/ISR +1.86 and p53 +1.03 log2 (p = 0.012); Cgas, STING, Tbk1, Irf3, Ifnb1 flat; ISG rises 92-100 % spill-over

short_title: OPCs are spared: ISR at spill-over level
method: ISR transcripts per 1k counts by lineage stage
key_result: OLs 4.21x control ISR; pure OPCs 1.19x, same as astrocytes 1.21x

short_title: Myelin RNA counted without segmentation: myelin genes lost, not OLs
method: All transcripts binned on 20 um grid, per OL and mm2
validation: Snap25 negative control; Sox10/Olig2 lineage controls
key_result: Mog -0.72 to -0.91 and Opalin -0.88 to -1.15 log2 per OL in every region; Sox10 unchanged; Mbp lags

short_title: Disease-free region map restores the responders' missing pallidum
method: Anatomy-gene label transfer: PCA plus logistic regression from controls
data: Per-cell counts of 400 anatomy genes, 20-NN pooled
key_result: Responder pallidum 0.04-0.68 % -> 1.8-3.9 % (controls 2.9-4.2 %); 23 % of responder fibre-tract cells are pallidum

short_title: Regional OL stress and microgliosis re-run on the disease-free map
method: Per-region OL tail share and microglia density, both maps
validation: Side-by-side original vs disease-free map; FDR
data: OL gene scores, cell table, new region labels
key_result: OL stress top in thalamus 28-36 % vs 8-11 %, pallidum joins; thalamus microglia p = 0.012; pallidum microglia p = 0.095

short_title: Responders share a response on data not used to call them
method: Held-out responder signature correlation; controls as null
validation: Exact permutation test; controls form the null
data: Xenium pseudobulk per mouse and cell type (analysis/01)
key_result: Microglia r 0.57-0.82 in responders vs -0.07 to 0.42 in controls (p 0.012); OLs without selection genes separate for 2 of 3 responders

short_title: Key per-mouse results with each responder left out
method: Leave-one-responder-out exact tests on 17 metrics
key_result: 10 of 15 expected-change metrics keep p = 0.036 with any responder dropped; Mbp loss, hypothalamus microgliosis, OL held-out signature rest on two responders

short_title: False-discovery control across test families of analyses 11-15
method: Benjamini-Hochberg within five test families and pooled
key_result: Pathway 11/11, myelin transcripts 45/65, regional 10/16, key metrics 16/17 at q < 0.10; density screen 0/42 (best q 0.25)

short_title: Reproducibility audit of all analysis notebooks
method: Scan notebooks for errors and gitignored inputs
key_result: 15 notebooks, 0 errors; gitignored inputs listed with regeneration script; analysis/16-17 not covered

short_title: Region x age DE re-run on the disease-free region map
method: pyDESeq2 pseudobulk per cell type x region x age
validation: Old vs new hit counts and log2FC correlation
key_result: 2,024 -> 2,007 significant genes; log2FC r 0.92-0.95 in main regions; striatum astrocytes P60 29 -> 1, hypothalamus microglia P60 12 -> 24

short_title: mtDSB gene sets and core genes in human MS OL nuclei
method: Pseudobulk gene-set scores, lesion vs control samples, exact tests
validation: Mouse mtDSB and EAE OL profiles as references
data: Four public MS snRNA atlases, 141k OL-lineage nuclei
key_result: TRIB3/GDF15/ATF5/EIF4EBP1 not raised in Absinta, Lerma-Martin; DDIT3 +1.0 to +2.9, CDKN1A +0.8 to +3.1 log2, plus IFN-gamma genes

short_title: Rare MS OLs carrying the mtDSB-specific markers
method: Per-nucleus marker-positive fractions; Lerma-Martin subtype scores
key_result: OLs with >= 2 specific transcripts 0-0.2 % (Schirmer 1.8-4.0 % vs 1.1 %); DDIT3+CDKN1A OLs 0.4-0.5 % vs 0 % (Absinta)

short_title: Genome-wide similarity of MS OLs to mtDSB and EAE
method: Pearson correlation of OL log2FC across species
unit: lesion type per atlas (genes as points)
data: Four MS snRNA atlases vs mouse mtDSB and EAE OL profiles
key_result: r with mtDSB 0.10-0.17 vs EAE 0.00-0.14 in the three larger atlases; all weak

short_title: Human Xenium: OL expression in demyelinated vs myelinated white matter
method: Myelin-RNA zones; zone pseudobulk log2 ratio within section
validation: Neighbouring non-OL cells as spill-over control
data: In-house human CNS Xenium 5k, 4 sections, 274k cells
key_result: Lesion OLs: TRIB3 +1.3/+1.4, CDKN1A +1.8/+2.3, BBC3 +1.7/+2.4, MOG -2.3/-2.6 log2; SOX10 flat; neighbours change little

short_title: Per-cell stress rates with spatial CIs and the tissue-border confound
method: Per-cell event rate ratios, spatial block bootstrap
validation: Border-distance strata; deep-tissue-only reanalysis; other cells
data: Human CNS Xenium 5k, two MS sections
key_result: Deep OLs: p21 3.1-3.4x, PUMA 3.2-3.3x, marker + p53 arm 3.7x and 10.5x (CIs > 1); TRIB3 alone CI includes 1

short_title: OL stress rises with local myelin loss away from the border
method: Binned per-cell rates by local myelin RNA; maps
data: Human CNS Xenium 5k, OLs > 400 um from border
key_result: Share of TRIB3+, CDKN1A+, BBC3+ OLs rises as myelin RNA falls in both MS sections (figure only, no statistic)
